name: Application Preparation
description: Builds the application package for a pursued opportunity from the organisation's uploaded documents: requirement checklist, gap analysis and drafts of every required component, followed by human review. Never submits anything externally.

inputs.name: components
inputs.description: Subset of components to (re)generate. Defaults to those the funder requires.

steps.name: Ingest organisation documents
steps.description: For any OrganisationDocument not yet extracted (pitch deck, CAC registration, reports, CVs), run document extraction and store text and structured facts. Update the organisation profile; facts without a document source stay verified=false.

steps.name: Extract application requirements
steps.description: Read the official application page and guidelines; produce a checklist of required questions, documents, word limits and formats.

steps.name: Gap analysis
steps.description: Match each requirement to knowledge-base evidence. States: met, partially_met, missing. Missing items create needsInput tasks for a human.

steps.name: Generate components
steps.description: For each required component (grant proposal, application responses, organisation profile, project summary, impact statement, founder biography, project budget, cover letter, supporting-documents checklist) generate a draft grounded in the knowledge base. Record the source document and locator for each factual claim.

steps.name: Grounding and fabrication check
steps.description: A second pass verifies that every number, credential, partnership and achievement in each draft appears in a cited source. Unsupported claims are removed and replaced with [[NEEDS_INPUT: ...]].

steps.name: Budget consistency check
steps.description: Verify budget lines sum to the total, stay within the funder's stated range and use the funder's currency.

onError.note: Mismatch sets the component to needs_input.

steps.name: Save application drafts
steps.description: Create or update the Application. Status is needs_input if any [[NEEDS_INPUT]] marker or missing requirement remains, otherwise in_review.

steps.name: Human review and approval
steps.description: An authorised reviewer edits and approves the package. Approval is required before the application can be marked ready_for_submission. Submission itself (portal or email) is performed by a human, or via WF-05 to WF-07 for email submissions.

steps.name: Record submission
steps.description: After a human submits through the funder portal or form, they record method, date and confirmation reference. The system never submits portal forms by itself.

aiInstructions.systemPrompt: You are a professional grant writer for {{organisation.tradingName}}. Write in clear, specific, evidence-led prose that follows the funder's own question wording and word limits. Use ONLY facts present in the supplied context (organisation profile, uploaded documents, retrieved page text). If a fact is missing, output null or a [[NEEDS_INPUT: description]] marker. Never invent credentials, statistics, URLs, deadlines or funding amounts. Mark every missing fact with [[NEEDS_INPUT: ...]].
guardrails: Never claim registration numbers, partnerships, awards, budgets or beneficiary counts that are not in a cited document.
Sample statistics (verified=false) may be used only with the wording "reported by the organisation" and must be flagged for confirmation.
Do not copy text from the funder's own materials into answers.
aiInstructions.outputFormat: JSON per component: { type, title, content, wordCount, sources[{documentId, locator}], needsInput[] }

output.description: Application with components, checklist, sources and review status.

onUnrecoverableFailure: Set the run status to "failed" and stop; never continue past a failed safety check.
Write a WorkflowLog entry with level "error" and the failing stepId.
Send an internal alert to INTERNAL_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL (internal only; never to external recipients).
errorHandling.idempotency: Every run carries a runId. Writes use natural keys (fingerprint, draftId, followUpId) so a retried run cannot create duplicates or send twice.

specificCases.action: Keep the file, mark extractedAt null, continue with remaining documents and flag the gap.

specificCases.condition: Grounding check removes more than 30% of a draft
specificCases.action: Set component to needs_input and request source documents instead of re-generating blindly.

approval.rationale: Applications make representations on behalf of the organisation. A human must approve before anything is submitted externally.

logging.redaction: Never log credentials, OAuth tokens or full email bodies. Log IDs and content hashes instead.

handoff.condition: Application.status == "ready_for_submission" and submission method is email, or an enquiry email is requested.

base44.automation: Entity automation on Opportunity status = pursue_approved; document-upload automation on OrganisationDocument create.
